versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Change Order Writer skill.

- Drafts complete, defensible construction change order requests, including entitlement basis, scope delta, and detailed pricing.
- Output includes contract-clause citation, schedule impact statement, itemised pricing breakdown (labour, material, equipment, subs, OH&P), and reservation of rights.
- Provides quality checklists and anti-patterns to ensure robust, auditable submissions.
- Guides users on required inputs and automatically identifies and flags missing information for confirmation.
- Produces output in a ready-to-send format suitable for contract correspondence.
